comments: Maker submission: I am the maker of this tool (VibeFix, Y.D.A. Dabeian S.A.). A check finds some issues, not all. It uses axe-core 4.14 and covers the part of WCAG 2.0 and 2.1, Levels A and AA, that software can test, not WCAG 2.2. It does not test keyboard use, focus, the cart or checkout.
features: Free, automated, read-only check of one page: a Shopify store's public homepage. Uses axe-core 4.14. Covers the part of WCAG 2.0 and 2.1 (Levels A and AA) that software can test, not WCAG 2.2. Does not test keyboard use, focus, the cart or checkout. Enter a store address; the report usually appears on the page in about a minute.
title: VibeFix Shopify Accessibility Checker
